transition.duration_formula: receiving_interval*(1-expm1(strength*novelty)/expm1(strength)); capped by configured fraction of receiving interval
transition.novelty_measurement: time-weighted mean or peak Foote in boundary window, clipped to 0..1
transition.timing: start exactly at original next segment start; never show next color before boundary
transition.missing_foote: use interval between original segment starts, subject only to configured percentage
transition.maximum_novelty: zero duration means an instantaneous color change

mapping.hue: atan2(sum(weight*sin(h)), sum(weight*cos(h))) modulo 360; all valid mapped scores participate; weight=score**hue_gamma; zero scores contribute zero

mapping.gamma_convention: output=input**gamma; hue gamma modifies weights, not hue angles

mapping.undefined_hue: no mapped color when no valid mapped tags exist or circular vectors cancel
